definitions.explanation: A group of people appointed or elected to perform a specific function, make decisions, or oversee particular matters. Found in government, schools, corporations, and other organizations.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}いましょう→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: Let's discuss it in the committee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧{委員会|いいんかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The budget committee will be held next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧{実行|じっこう}{委員会|いいんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I joined the school cultural festival organizing committee and was in charge of everything from planning to management.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ (committee member) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meeting, group).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧{委員会|いいんかい}: budget committee
- {実行|じっこう}{委員会|いいんかい}: executive/organizing committee
- {選挙管理|せんきょかんり}{委員会|いいんかい}: election management committee
- {教育|きょういく}{委員会|いいんかい}: board of education
- {委員会|いいんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to establish a committee
- {委員会|いいんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a committee meeting
- ⟦{常任|じょうにん}→常任：30013_jounin⟧{委員会|いいんかい}: standing committee

USAGE:
Very common in both formal government contexts (e.g., Diet committees) and everyday contexts (school committees, neighborhood associations). In Japanese schools, students participate in various {委員会|いいんかい} like the ⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧{委員会|いいんかい} (library committee) and ⟦{保健|ほけん}→保健：11616_hoken⟧{委員会|いいんかい} (health committee).
